zh.lead: 今天最吵的故事，是巨型 AI 公司的资产负债表。但真正能卖给 builder 的信号更小，也更靠近收件箱：Please don't spam people looking for employment 引发 251 条讨论，6 月招聘串又引发 339 和 425 条评论，Indie Hackers 上“零受众拿到 50 个用户”的帖子也有 134 条评论。人们并不缺消息；他们缺的是证明：这条消息真的是对方想收到的吗？

build.title: Audience Reality Receipt
build.oneLiner: 给 solo founder 的买家证据报告，用来测试一个产品想法是否能在 AI 生成的市场故事、build-in-public 点赞和冷触达垃圾信息之外，找到够得着的客户；背后证据是求职串滥用引发 251 条讨论，以及 Indie Hackers 上“零受众拿到 50 个用户”引发 134 条评论。

signals: 冷触达已经从增长技巧越界成了社会伤害：Please don't spam people looking for employment 引发 251 条讨论，而 6 月招聘和求职串又围绕被抓取的联系方式、假机会和垃圾信息工厂增加了 764 条评论。
AI 资金正在变成公开市场基础设施：Can the stockmarket swallow Anthropic, SpaceX and OpenAI? 引发 1,182 条讨论，Anthropic's draft S-1 引发 438 条讨论，OpenAI models and Codex on AWS 则补上了分发角度。
包安装仍然是活的安全边界：Malicious npm packages detected across Red Hat Cloud Services 引发 445 条讨论，DepsGuard 则作为一条命令加固 package-manager 默认设置的方式发布。

en.lead: The loud story is giant AI balance sheets. The sellable builder signal is smaller and closer to the inbox: Please don't spam people looking for employment drew 251 comments, the June hiring threads drew 339 and 425 comments, and Indie Hackers had 134 comments on getting 50 users with zero audience. People do not lack messages; they lack proof that the message is wanted.

build.title: Audience Reality Receipt
build.oneLiner: a buyer-evidence report for solo founders that tests whether a product idea has reachable customers outside AI-generated market stories, build-in-public likes, and cold-outreach spam, backed by 251 comments on job-thread abuse and 134 Indie Hackers comments on getting 50 users with zero audience.

signals: Cold outreach crossed from growth tactic into social harm: Please don't spam people looking for employment drew 251 comments, while the June hiring and job-seeker threads added 764 comments around scraped contact details, fake opportunities, and spam farms.

AI money is becoming public-market infrastructure: Can the stockmarket swallow Anthropic, SpaceX and OpenAI? drew 1,182 comments, Anthropic's draft S-1 drew 438, and OpenAI models and Codex on AWS added the distribution angle.

Package installs stayed a live security boundary: Malicious npm packages detected across Red Hat Cloud Services drew 445 comments, and DepsGuard launched as a one-command way to harden package-manager defaults.
